theorem Roth.exists_hasseDeriv_eval_ne_zero.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) {c : ℝ},
      Roth.index P α r < c → ∃ k, Roth.weight r k < c ∧ (eval α) ((hasseDeriv k) P) ≠ 0 :=
fun {σ} [Fintype σ] {P} hP α r {c} hc ↦
  Exists.imp
    (fun x x_1 ↦
      match x_1 with
      | ⟨hd, hw⟩ => ⟨Eq.symm hw ▸ hc, hd⟩)
    (Roth.exists_weight_eq_index hP α r)

WITNESS254_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ},
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) {c : ℝ},
      Roth.index P α r < c → ∃ (k : σ →₀ ℕ), Roth.weight r k < c ∧ (eval α) ((hasseDeriv k) P) ≠ 0
